notes.title: A major update making the game easier
notes.content:
The game has been updated to version 0.8.63.138.

Added a difficulty choice at the beginning of the game between:
- Easy (Inferior Reaper);
All enemy stats are reduced by 35%.
- Normal (Battle Reaper);
All enemy stats are reduced by 25%.
- Hard (Higher Reaper);
Enemy stats are unchanged.

Added a Death blessing window to make it easier to complete if you encounter an impossible challenge.
The list of blessings includes:
1. Instant death of all enemies.
2. Receiving any consumable.
3. Receiving any weapon (except story ones).
4. Receiving any armor.
5. Receiving any item to modify armor and weapons.
6. Receiving any amount of currency.

Enjoy! :3
